extension.description: One-click upload of local images in Markdown / MDX documents to a CloudFlare ImgBed image host, with links written back into the document. Paste-screenshot auto upload, remote image re-hosting, and custom CDN link rewriting.
workspaceTrust.description: Settings such as the upload URL and channel can be overridden by the workspace; in Restricted Mode only user-level settings are read, so an untrusted repository cannot send your images to a third-party server.
cmd.uploadAll: Upload All Local Images in Document
config.imgbedUploader.serverUrl.descript: Image host base URL, e.g. https://img.example.com
config.imgbedUploader.authType.descripti: Authentication method: upload auth code / API Token (requires the upload permission) / no auth (when the server has user-side auth disabled). Credentials are entered via the "Set Credentials" command and stored in SecretStorage
config.imgbedUploader.channelName.descri: Channel name when multiple channels of the same type are configured; leave empty for the server default
config.imgbedUploader.uploadFolder.descr: Upload folder (relative path, e.g. img/test); leave empty for the root
config.imgbedUploader.uploadNameType.des: File naming: prefix_original name / prefix only / original name only / short link
config.imgbedUploader.expire.description: File expiration (e.g. 12h, 7d, forever); only applies when the server enables expiration and allows uploaders to choose, otherwise ignored
config.imgbedUploader.serverCompress.des: Server-side compression (only applies to images on the Telegram channel)
config.imgbedUploader.autoRetry.descript: Automatically switch channels and retry on upload failure
config.imgbedUploader.customCdn.descript: Custom CDN / URL prefix (e.g. https://cdn.example.com/file/); https:// may be omitted (auto-completed); CDNs that only support http must write http:// explicitly
config.imgbedUploader.uploadRemoteImages: Re-host remote images when uploading a document in one click: images not in the whitelist are downloaded, re-uploaded to the image host, and rewritten
config.imgbedUploader.remoteWhitelist.de: Remote image domain whitelist (e.g. img.shields.io); matching URLs are left untouched; exact match on the URL hostname
config.imgbedUploader.pasteUpload.descri: Pasting an image into a Markdown / MDX document auto-uploads it to the image host and inserts the link; when off, VS Code's default behavior applies
